No measured operation runs new code (ADR-034, G13 verification plan item 4). The slow mode of the contended lease appears on both commits: 18 of 40 kernel windows at 8 and 32 callers on b7071ed, 7 of 20 in the valid run on 17283a8 (11 of 20 in the invalid run). The difference between A and B lies within the spread of the slow mode that the section "2026-11-22 call-path gate on the merge commit" of ADR-034 describes, so it is no finding to explain before the merge. Item 4 also runs the gate again on the merge commit into main, once that merge exists.
